answer: Like mycelium forming an organic garden across stony soil, decentralized consensus anchors agents into mutual staking lattices. To mimic trust, an adversary must mint faux identities like soft copper pretending to be unyielding onyx. Requiring edge-weighted bonding curves enforces superlinear attacker cost: each synthetic node demands geometrically compounding collateral, starving clones of root capital before they can corrupt the swarm.
